finding_resolutions.violated_requirement: speckit-plan Phase 1 step 3 requires a quickstart validation guide with prerequisites, setup commands, test/run commands, expected outcomes, and references to contracts/data model.
finding_resolutions.resolution: Current substantive guide supplies standard-library Python prerequisites, a concrete fixture preparation command, future unittest and CLI commands, exact success-byte expectations, rejection statuses/channels, input immutability and repeatability checks, representative large-file validation, and references to the CLI contract and data model. It explicitly distinguishes pending implementation from performed validation.

semantic_coverage.FR-001: One-path invocation, quoted paths, no stdin, and zero/two argument rejection checks.
semantic_coverage.FR-002: Strict UTF-8, invalid-byte rejection, and preserved decomposed Unicode/non-ASCII whitespace example.
semantic_coverage.FR-003: ASCII space/tab edge trimming with interior tab and non-ASCII whitespace preservation.
semantic_coverage.FR-004: Interior whitespace, interior blank lines, and trailing LF preservation examples.
semantic_coverage.FR-005: Exact CRLF and bare-CR conversion examples.
semantic_coverage.FR-006: Original empty input remains empty; nonempty ASCII whitespace-only input yields exactly LF; existing trailing LFs remain.
semantic_coverage.FR-007: Stdout-only result, saved input-byte comparison, and explicit distinction between shell captures and utility file writes.
semantic_coverage.FR-008: Missing path, directory, and invalid UTF-8 require status 2, nonempty stderr, and zero stdout, including partial-output detection.
semantic_coverage.FR-009: Representative large finite input with complete expected-output comparison; no product cutoff or invented throughput promise.
semantic_coverage.SC-001: All accepted exact examples plus Unicode and interior-tab cases have expected bytes.
semantic_coverage.SC-002: Rejection status and both output channels explicitly checked.
semantic_coverage.SC-003: Repeated unchanged-input invocations compare status and both channels.

preserved_designs.plan.md: Byte-identical to controlled-history original; technical context, requirement mapping, constitution gates and resource risk retained.
preserved_designs.research.md: Byte-identical; literal LF splitting, strict decoding, original-input emptiness and atomic output decisions retained.
preserved_designs.data-model.md: Byte-identical; transient entities, validation and lifecycle retained.
preserved_designs.contracts/cli.md: Byte-identical; interface, exact examples and rejection guarantees retained.

constitution_review: Standard-library-only, local deterministic design and unit-test validation remain consistent with the constitution. All nine accepted product decisions are preserved; no material constitutional gap found.
scope_verification: normalize_text.py and tests/test_normalize_text.py are absent. Quickstart contains validation instructions rather than implementation bodies or a complete test suite.
limitations: This review establishes planning-artifact adequacy. Future implementation commands were inspected, not executed; runtime behavior and feature acceptance are not established.
